messages:
sara: Quick handoff for tonight — wrapping up. Main points: gpu-v2 pool sitting at ~74% overall, short bursts consumed ~12% in last 6h, burst tokens remaining ~1.9k. Customer 'atlas-ml' had two medium jobs this evening that spiked seq len; they finished ~30m ago. No open incidents.

leo: thanks — any scheduled cron jobs we should watch overnight?

sara: only atlas-ml batch at 02:30 UTC (one-off job), and infra/maintenance window at 04:00 UTC for node firmware patch (non-preemptible nodes flagged). I left the patch tagged no-auto-drain in case we need to preserve capacity.

maria: quick check — pool autoscaler is on scale-down delay 10m, scale-up 1m. If atlas-ml job spikes >85% we should consider temporary quota bump from dedicated reserve. I can approve if needed. :eyes:

aj: ping for CR review if we need to flip fallback policy: PR #886 changes model-fallback order to v2-small -> v1-medium. If we roll that during morning canary it reduces peak token cost.

leo: thx, noted. If we do quota bump, what's the rollback plan?\
maria: rollback is manual reduce of pool quota + force-evict non-critical spot tasks. Command to inspect current tokens:```rdrwctl pools metrics --pool=gpu-v2 --fields=utilization,burst_tokens```

deploy-bot: Deployment queued: infra/firmware-patch @2026-03-18T04:00:00Z — no-drain flag set by sara.

sara: FYI I'm leaving an annotation on the pool: "handoff: monitor atlas-ml @02:30UTC; patch @04:00 no-drain". If you take over, please watch for sustained >88% for 5m.

leo: I'll cover 01:45–05:00 UTC. If we hit sustained >90% for 3m escalate to maria, else try temporary reserve allocation.

maria: copy. If space is tight, move fallback for low-priority customers to v1-medium (lower perf) rather than throttling. Will be available on pager if needed.

aj: quick note — I've added a small e2e test to simulate atlas-ml job in staging, might be useful tomorrow morning for verifying fallback behavior.

sara: awesome, thanks all. leaving the shift — ping me if anything unusual. :thumbsup:
